answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. By the nebula of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The fable holds work receipts rather than names, so the comet of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
